title: Cobblemon Towns - Pokemon Adventure
description: Start your cobblemon town! Embark on a Pokemon expeditions with friends and play cobblemon like you've never played before!
body:
Embark in a TOWN Adventure with your friends
Fight against raid bosses in expeditions!

Enjoy all 1000+ pokemons including some fakemons

The server is always updating with the latest cobblemon and features!
